description: Sobo Beaches helps you find and book beach huts for your holiday. Tell ChatGPT where and when you want to go, your budget, and what matters most (location, view, dog friendly, accessibility). The app returns matching huts with key details and a link to complete your booking on sobobeaches.com.

defaultPrompt: I want a beach hut in Bournemouth from 10 to 12 July 2026 for 2 adults.
